accountSetup.title: Tell us about your business
accountSetup.description: This helps NovaLight tailor content ideas to your industry from the very first draft.
accountSetup.verticalQuestion: Which of these best describes your business?
accountSetup.verticalHint: This sets the starting point for your brand profile — you can refine everything in the next step.

verticalDescriptions.BEAUTY_SALON: Hair, nails, skincare, spa, and similar personal-care services
verticalDescriptions.CAFE: Coffee shops, bakeries, and casual all-day spots
verticalDescriptions.LOCAL_SERVICE: Repair, home, wellness, or other in-person service businesses
verticalDescriptions.RETAIL: Shops selling physical products directly to customers

brandSetup.title: Build your brand profile
brandSetup.description: Answer in your own words — NovaLight turns this into a structured brand profile you can review before anything is used.
brandSetup.suggestionsLabel: Need a starting point? Tap any that fit:
brandSetup.suggestionsHint: Tapping a suggestion adds it to your answer — edit or remove anything, and write your own from scratch at any time.
brandSetup.reviewDescription: Here's what we'll save. You can come back and edit this anytime.
brandSetup.error: We couldn't save your brand profile. Please try again.

tone.label: In a few words, how would you describe your brand's tone?
tone.description: Think about how you'd want a customer to feel reading your posts.
tone.placeholder: e.g. Warm and welcoming, with a bit of playful humor

audience.label: Who is your typical customer?
audience.description: Age range, lifestyle, what they're looking for — whatever comes to mind.
audience.placeholder: e.g. Busy professionals in their 30s who want quick, healthy options

visual.label: How would you describe your visual style?
visual.description: Colors, mood, photography style — anything that captures your look.
visual.placeholder: e.g. Bright, clean, and minimal with lots of natural light

offerings.label: What do you offer?
offerings.description: Your main products or services, in your own words.
offerings.placeholder: e.g. Specialty coffee, fresh pastries, and a cozy space to work
